purpose: Rank candidate trajectories for later evidence-final self-verification by researcher value and architecture-falsification pressure, not fame or source convenience.

pressure: failed phase-3 hypothesis -> biomarker refinement -> later success
ranked_candidates.why_researcher_value: Shows why a final 'successful' label destroys the historical learning path.
A compact cognition-to-capital-allocation-to-failure arc with clear hindsight risk.
A success trajectory that stresses almost every generic relation without being a failure-only benchmark.
Directly tests China-linked global identity and rights semantics.
Separates monotherapy failure, regulatory withdrawal, safety burden and ongoing scientific viability.
Likely to falsify simplistic single-target or single-owner primitives if evidence supports the remembered structure.
Tests whether regimen identity is modeled without attributing combination benefit to the ADC alone.

selection_note: Candidates 5-7 remain strong reserves. Actual evidence tasks may reorder after name/rights/readout self-verification; no candidate is a Fact merely because it ranks highly here.
